# Code of conduct

## The short version

Be decent. Assume the other person is trying to help.

## What is expected

- Talk about the code, not the person.
- Accept that people are in different time zones, speak different first languages, and have
  different amounts of experience.
- If someone's English is not perfect, read for the meaning.

## What is not accepted

Harassment, insults, personal attacks, and unwelcome attention of any kind.

## If something goes wrong

Contact the repository owner through the email on their GitHub profile. Reports are read and handled
privately.
